judgments.comparative_verdict: Both reports are thorough, technically correct, and hit all four expectations; they are comparable in quality.

report_1.evidence: Target **`main`** ... Had the dependency still been open, the correct move would have been a stacked PR based on `feat/weighted-scorer`; since it is merged, `main` is the only sensible base.

report_2.evidence: The PR should target `main`. ... The only alternative candidate — `feat/weighted-scorer`, the branch this work was actually built on — must not be used, because it is a dead base: its content has already been merged into `main`

report_1.evidence: It was created from the **tip of `feat/weighted-scorer`** ... `git merge-base --is-ancestor feat/weighted-scorer main` exits 1 ... PR #42 collapsed W1–W3 into the single commit `1971f08` on main, byte-for-byte identical in content

report_2.evidence: `feat/weighted-scorer` has already been merged into `main` via a squash-merge ... `git merge-base --is-ancestor feat/weighted-scorer main` fails (its commits W1 `d6fdbc3`, W2 `2d3029b`, W3 `ac9d505` are *not* ancestors of main) ... merged as PR #42

report_1.evidence: `scoring/scorer.py`: +13/−3 — rewrites the scorer from flat metrics to weighted aggregation ... **No, not all of it is pairwise work.** ... it appears in the PR-style diff only because the W commits remain in this branch's ancestry while main carries the same content under a different commit, pinning the merge-base back at `65204ad`

report_2.evidence: `scoring/scorer.py`: +13/−3 ... **entirely weighted-scorer work (W1/W2), none of it pairwise**. ... appears in the PR diff only because the branch's merge-base with main predates the squash-merge

report_1.evidence: `git rebase --onto main feat/weighted-scorer feat/pairwise-metric` ... `git diff main...feat/pairwise-metric` should now equal the 5-line pairwise-only delta ... `git fetch origin`, then verify `origin/main` hasn't moved past `1971f08`

report_2.evidence: `git rebase --onto main feat/weighted-scorer feat/pairwise-metric` ... `git diff main...feat/pairwise-metric --stat` must show only `prompts/grader.txt` (+1) and `scoring/metrics.py` (+4). Also confirm `git merge-base --is-ancestor main feat/pairwise-metric` now succeeds
